answer: Require each new identity to complete a live, randomly assigned group task with strangers: a short synchronous puzzle where teammates must exchange observations in real time, like tracing a plume of dye across an ocean chart and marking the marble quarry it reaches. The cohort is drawn minutes before start, so one operator cannot staff many seats at once; each fake identity needs a separate live participant, a separate device session, and a fresh fee. Correlated timing or identical answers expose colluding cohorts, and every member loses standing.
